header: Fluid components in Astryx for TYPO3
text: Version 2.0 introduced the component layer with 89 components in four layers. Version 2.1 brought it to 189, and all 250 content elements compose from them.
note: From the release notes: 2.0.0 on 13 September 2026, 2.1.0 on 19 September 2026. The editor types the figure and the change; nothing is calculated.
